description: Searches the Agents Handbook for playbooks that match a real-world job done with an AI agent, described in plain words (for example 'cancel subscriptions from email receipts' or 'turn tickets into pull requests'). Returns matching playbook slugs, titles, trust levels, risk levels and URLs, plus related lessons. The slugs work with get_playbook.

agent.description: Optional agent slug to filter by, for example claude-code, codex, chatgpt-agent, claude-in-chrome, n8n.

name: search_playbooks
title: Search playbooks
